rationale: The only code-level difference is that the fixed implementation clears the DTE facilities output structure with memset(dte, 0, sizeof(*dte)) before parsing. The Logic section states only that facilities structures are initialized and that incoming facilities are parsed and negotiated; it does not specifically state that the DTE structure is zero-initialized. All other described parsing, reverse-charging handling, negotiation, updates, and debug logging occur in both versions.
